title: Yesser Pack
description: A bunch of QOL and visual mods I like to use
body:
# Yesser Pack Yesser Pack is a pack of QOL and visual mods I like to use. It is a collection of mods that fix the parts of vanilla that have always felt a bit unpolished — inventory management, sound effects and visuals, LODs so you can see the world without your computer crying for air, some shaders and a bunch of visual and audio polish. The game still plays like vanilla, it just feels much better. ## Important mods: - [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) - see *very* far - [Dynamic Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamiccrosshair) - morphs crosshair according to what you're looking at and what you're holding - [Chest Separators](https://modrinth.com/mod/chest-separators) - Draw separators in a chest's grid - [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) - better inventory controls - [Immersive UI](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-ui), [Immersive Hotbar](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-hotbar), [Inventory Particles](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-particles), [Obscure Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/obscure-tooltips) - UI visual effects - [Perception](https://modrinth.com/mod/perception), [Presence Footsteps](https://modrinth.com/mod/presence-footsteps), [Cool Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/coolrain), [Punchy](https://modrinth.com/mod/punchy-fpa), [Cursors Extended](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-cursor) - sound effects, animations, VFX - [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade), [Death Sorter](https://modrinth.com/mod/death-sorter) - QOL mods - [MakeUp - Ultra Fast](https://modrinth.com/shader/makeup-ultra-fast-shaders) - shader ## FAQ - **Q:** Will this work client-side?
A: Yes (except death sorter). - **Q:** Why does it lag just after joining/creating a world?
A: Distant Horizons is loading LOD chunks. The first few seconds are the worst but DH will continue more slowly after a small radius has been generated. - **Q:** ...but my PC is a potato!
A: I used a bunch of optimisation mods and the game runs very fast even with the shader (on my GTX 1070 I'm getting a stable 80 FPS; tested on Linux, Windows might eat up more of your FPS).
If you're still getting low frames, try disabling the shader (with K). - **Q:** You used my mod but I don't want it to be included!
A: Please contact me at the e-mail shown on [my YT channel](https://www.youtube.com/@yesseruser) (Click `more...` on the channel description and click `Show e-mail address`). - **Q:** What in the world are those keybinds???
A: Those are the keybinds I like to play with (needs a mouse with side buttons). Feel free to change them if you don't like mine! ## Mod list The full mod list is available in your [version](https://modrinth.com/modpack/yesser-pack/versions)'s page under `Dependencies`.
